reference_sql:
WITH promo_product AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in April 2025 and product in it
  SELECT p.promo_id, pp.product_id, p.start_date
  FROM promotions p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  WHERE p.start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-04-30'
), during AS (
  -- one row per promotion and product sold on it
  SELECT ol.promo_id, ol.product_id, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
  FROM order_lines ol
  GROUP BY ol.promo_id, ol.product_id
), baseline AS (
  -- one row per promotion and product with a baseline sale
  SELECT x.promo_id, x.product_id, SUM(s.units) AS units
  FROM promo_product x
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = x.product_id
    AND s.order_date BETWEEN x.start_date - 14 AND x.start_date - 1
  GROUP BY x.promo_id, x.product_id
)
SELECT x.promo_id, x.product_id, COALESCE(d.units, 0) AS promo_units, COALESCE(b.units, 0) AS baseline_units
FROM promo_product x
LEFT JOIN during d ON d.promo_id = x.promo_id AND d.product_id = x.product_id
LEFT JOIN baseline b ON b.promo_id = x.promo_id AND b.product_id = x.product_id

solver.query:
WITH promo AS (
  SELECT promo_id, start_date, end_date, end_date - start_date + 1 AS days
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-04-30'
), dur AS (
  SELECT ol.promo_id, ol.product_id, SUM(s.units) AS units
  FROM order_lines ol JOIN sales s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  WHERE ol.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promo)
  GROUP BY ol.promo_id, ol.product_id
), base AS (
  SELECT p.promo_id, pp.product_id, SUM(s.units) AS units
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND s.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date - 14 AND p.start_date - 1
  GROUP BY p.promo_id, pp.product_id
)
SELECT p.promo_id, pp.product_id, COALESCE(d.units, 0) AS promo_units, COALESCE(b.units, 0) AS baseline_units
FROM promo p
JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
LEFT JOIN dur d ON d.promo_id = p.promo_id AND d.product_id = pp.product_id
LEFT JOIN base b ON b.promo_id = p.promo_id AND b.product_id = pp.product_id
